
## Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)  # read_csv and mutate
library(lme4)       # lmer
library(emmeans)    # emmeans and pairs
library(lmerTest)
library(ordinal)
library(performance)
library(modelsummary)
library(lmerTest)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

df_corr <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/df_corr_for_R_Study5.csv"
)

df_codes <- read_csv(
  "/Users/sm6511/Desktop/Prediction-Accomodation-Exp/data/Combined/explanationcodes/Explanation_Coding_Study5.csv"
)

# Clean participant IDs in df_corr (extract number)
df_corr_clean <- df_corr %>%
  mutate(
    participant = str_extract(as.character(participant), "(?<=np\\.int64\\()\\d+"),
    participant = as.integer(participant)
  )

# Replace NA explanation codes with 0, treat unused explanation column as none
df_codes_clean <- df_codes %>%
  mutate(
    participant = as.integer(participant),
    None = replace_na(None, 0),
    Explanation = replace_na(Explanation, 0),
    Causal_Explanation = replace_na(Causal_Explanation, 0),
    explanation_type = case_when(
      Causal_Explanation == 1 ~ "causal_explanation",
      None == 1 ~ "none",
      Explanation == 1 ~ "none",   # treat Explanation as none
      TRUE ~ "other_or_uncoded"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(participant, explanation_type, None, Causal_Explanation)

df_corr_coded <- df_corr_clean %>%
  left_join(df_codes_clean, by = "participant") %>%
  mutate(
    task_explanation_group = case_when(
      task == "predict" ~ "predict",
      task == "accommodate" & explanation_type == "none" ~ "accommodate_none",
      task == "accommodate" & explanation_type == "Explanation" ~ "accommodate_none",
      task == "accommodate" & explanation_type == "causal_explanation" ~ "accommodate_causal",
      TRUE ~ "other_or_uncoded"
    ),
    task_explanation_group = factor(
      task_explanation_group,
      levels = c("predict", "accommodate_causal", "accommodate_none")
    ),
    feature_relevance = factor(
      feature_relevance,
      levels = c("irrelevant", "relevant")
    ),
    feature_dimension = factor(
      feature_dimension,
      levels = c("stripes", "feet")
      
    )
  )

df_corr_coded %>%
  count(task_explanation_group)

```


```{r}
contrasts(df_corr_coded$task_explanation_group) <- contr.sum(3)
contrasts(df_corr_coded$feature_relevance) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_corr_coded$feature_dimension) <- contr.sum(2)

model_eff <- lmer(
  correlation ~ task_explanation_group * feature_relevance *
    feature_dimension +
    (1|participant),
  data = df_corr_coded
)
summary(model_eff)
```

```{r}
emm <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ feature_relevance * task_explanation_group)
contrast(emm, interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise"), by = NULL)
emm <- emmeans(model_eff, ~ feature_dimension * task_explanation_group)
contrast(emm, interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise"), by = NULL)
```
```{r}
plot_df <- df_corr_coded %>%
  group_by(task_explanation_group, feature_dimension) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  plot_df,
  aes(
    x = feature_dimension,
    y = mean,
    color = task_explanation_group,
    group = task_explanation_group
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = .3),
    size = 3
  ) +
  geom_line(
    position = position_dodge(width = .3)
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean - se,
      ymax = mean + se
    ),
    width = .15,
    position = position_dodge(width = .3)
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Feature Dimension",
    y = "Correlation",
    color = "Task"
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

summary_df <- df_corr_coded %>%
  filter(!is.na(task_explanation_group)) %>%
  group_by(task_explanation_group, feature_dimension, feature_relevance) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(correlation, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci = qt(.975, n - 1) * se,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(
  summary_df,
  aes(x = task_explanation_group,
      y = mean,
      color = task_explanation_group)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean - ci,
      ymax = mean + ci
    ),
    width = 0.15
  ) +
  facet_grid(feature_dimension ~ feature_relevance) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Correlation"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Study 5")
```

```{r}
df_corr_coded <- df_corr_coded %>% mutate(
  task_explanation_group = factor(task_explanation_group),
  feature_relevance = factor(feature_relevance),
  feature_dimension = factor(feature_dimension)
  )
levels(df_corr_coded$task_explanation_group)
# Effect / sum coding
contrasts(df_corr_coded$task_explanation_group) <- contr.sum(3)
contrasts(df_corr_coded$feature_relevance) <- contr.sum(2)
contrasts(df_corr_coded$feature_dimension) <- contr.sum(2)
model_corr_raw_eff <- lmer(
  correlation ~ task_explanation_group * feature_relevance * feature_dimension +
    (1 | participant),
  data = df_corr_coded
)
summary(model_corr_raw_eff)

library(emmeans)

emm <- emmeans(model_corr_raw_eff, ~ task_explanation_group)
pairs(emm)
```
